rights_basis: Bounded received English on ordinary numbered Lasance/Walsh 1945-edition pages 1265-1268, under the registration-specific United States nonrenewal basis in src/sources/inventories/lasance-new-roman-missal-rights-v1.toml. Excludes every later lettered insert; no contemporary approved-English status is asserted.
text: Blessed are the clean of heart, for they shall see God: blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called the children of God: blessed are they that suffer persecution for justice's sake, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
